summary: Summary contracts use saved per-fold scores.

refits.scope: The representatives use three classical methods and five seeds. Other registered cells use benchmark/refit_registered.py.
The analysis uses nine arms, five seeds and the retained-intercept rule.
Within-cell k-TSP uses seed 101 and the calibration-analysis calibrators.
The analysis uses eleven arms and repetition 1. All 132000 scores, thresholds and calls match exactly.
Training uses array 1 and testing uses array 2 in repetition 1. All 217689 specified scores, thresholds and decisions match exactly.
Breast-cancer k-TSP transfer uses seed 101 and all three held-out targets. Across 628 scores, the maximum baseline error is 1.03028696685215e-13.
Four released weighted inequalities and first-class tie rule. 107 target scores and calls match exactly. Fixed published weights are applied without classifier fitting.

limitations: Full small-RNA FASTQ quantification and all registered refits require additional computation.
